screen.title: Conversation: Narrowing a paper topic
screen.prompt: Listen to a conversation between a student and a professor.

audio.text: Professor Wright, could I talk to you about my paper on social media and news habits?
Of course. I read your outline. It's ambitious, maybe a little too ambitious for ten pages.
I was worried about that. I'm trying to cover four different countries.
Why not pick the one where you've found the most reliable data? You could mention the others briefly in your conclusion.
That would probably be Brazil. I found a really solid survey from last year.
Then start there, and send me a revised outline by Monday.

questions.stem: What is the professor's main concern?
options: The student's outline was submitted a week late.
The survey data is several years old.
The project is too broad for the assignment.
The student chose the wrong country.

why.en: Main concern (paraphrase of "too ambitious for ten pages"). B contradicts "a really solid survey from last year".
why.tr: Ana endişe ("on sayfa için fazla iddialı" parafrazı). B "geçen yılın sağlam anketi" bilgisiyle çelişiyor.
why.es: Preocupación principal (paráfrasis de "too ambitious for ten pages"). B contradice "a really solid survey from last year".

questions.stem: What will the student probably do next?
options: Meet the professor again on Monday
Discuss four countries in his conclusion
Look for a more recent survey
Focus his paper on a single country

why.en: Inference: he will start with Brazil only. A twists the Monday deadline for the outline into a meeting.
why.tr: Çıkarım: yalnızca Brezilya ile başlayacak. A taslak için verilen Pazartesi tarihini bir görüşmeye çeviriyor.
why.es: Inferencia: empezará solo con Brasil. A convierte la fecha límite del esquema del lunes en una reunión.
